======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Ajay Mukherjee, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Parmeshwar Mehta, App
 ====================================================

==
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 09-07-2025 Heard Mr. Ajay Mukherjee, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Shambhuganj P.S. Case No. 184 of 2022 for the offence registered under Sections 406, 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of the IPC lodged on 17.07.2022 by the informant Mithilesh Kumar Jaiswal.

3. As per the prosecution story, the informant, the next Branch Manager of Bhagalpur Central Co-operative Bank Limited, Shambhuganj alleged that the earlier Branch Manager along with this petitioner who was serving as cashier, defalcated Rs.1,13,245/- from Migra Account during the period of 17.01.2013 to 06.06.2013.

entities.text: Bhagalpur Central Co-operative Bank Limited, Shambhuganj
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that it was a discrepency and not misappropriation, in any case, the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.41141 of 2025(2) dt.09-07-2025 Branch Manager has deposited Rs. 1,13,245/- and has since been extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

His further submission is that without accepting the allegation and/or the outcome of the present petition, the petitioner also would like to deposit half of the amount i.e. Rs. 55,000/- approximately addressed to the Bhagalpur Central Co-operative Bank Limited, Shambhuganj.

entities.text: Bhagalpur Central Co-operative Bank Limited, Shambhuganj
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 5. Learned APP for the State, on the other hand, opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail submitting that he along with the Branch Manager serving with the said Bank, misappropriated the money.

sentences.text: 6. Allegation is there, the petitioner was serving at the relevant time in the Bank aforesaid, the Branch Manager has since been extended relief in Cr. Misc. No. 44329 of 2024 on 24.07.2024 by a co-ordinate Bench.

This Court also follows the same rule and allowed the anticipatory bail of the petitioner subject to payment of Rs. 55,000/- approximately addressed to the Bhagalpur Central Co-operative Bank Limited, Shambhuganj.
7.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: (iv) the petitioner shall desist from committing any criminal offence again failing which the State shall be at liberty to take steps for cancellation of the bail bonds.

(Rajiv Roy, J) priyanka/-
